title: nf-core/fspassemblypipeline pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

file_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'. Alternatively, for BAM input, this can be the path to the BAM file (must have extension '.bam')

file_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fasta.errorMessage: Fasta file for BAM input must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fa.gz' or '.fasta.gz'

taxid.errorMessage: Species TaxiID for decontamination screening, must be a valid NCBI Taxonomy ID (positive integer)
